segment.source: RDAccess: Remote Desktop Accessibility
segment.target: 远程桌面无障碍 #

segment.source: Authors: [Leonard de Ruijter][1]
segment.target: 作者： [Leonard de Ruijter][1]

segment.source: Download [latest stable version][2]
segment.target: 下载[最新稳定版][2]

segment.source: NVDA compatibility: 2026.1 and later
segment.target: NVDA兼容性：2026.1及更高版本

segment.source: The RDAccess add-on (Remote Desktop Accessibility) adds support for Microsoft Remote Desktop, Citrix, Parallels RAS, or VMware Horizon remote sessions to NVDA.
segment.target: RDAccess 插件（Remote Desktop Accessibility，远程桌面无障碍）为 NVDA 添加了对 Microsoft 远程桌面、Citrix、Parallels RAS 或 VMware Horizon 远程会话的支持。

segment.source: When installed on both the client and the server in NVDA, speech and braille generated on the server will be spoken and displayed in braille on the client machine.
segment.target: 当在客户端和服务器上的 NVDA 中都安装此插件后，服务器上生成的语音和盲文将在客户端计算机上读出和（通过盲文点显器）显示。

segment.source: This enables a user experience where managing a remote system feels as seamless as operating the local system.
segment.target: 这使得管理远程系统如同本地操作般的无缝体验。

segment.source: Features
segment.target: 功能特性

segment.source: Support for Microsoft Remote Desktop (including Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft Cloud PC), Citrix, Parallels RAS, and VMware Horizon
segment.target: 支持 Microsoft 远程桌面（包括 Azure 虚拟桌面和 Microsoft 云电脑）、Citrix、Parallels RAS 和 VMware Horizon

segment.source: Speech and braille output
segment.target: 语音和盲文输出

segment.source: Automatic detection of remote braille using NVDA's automatic braille display detection
segment.target: 使用 NVDA 的盲文点显器自动检测功能来自动检测远程盲文

segment.source: Automatic detection of remote speech using a dedicated detection process that can be disabled in NVDA's settings dialog
segment.target: 使用专用的检测进程自动检测远程语音（可在 NVDA 设置对话框中禁用）

segment.source: Support for portable copies of NVDA running on a server (additional configuration required for Citrix)
segment.target: 支持在服务器上运行的 NVDA 便携版（Citrix 需要额外配置）

segment.source: Full support for portable copies of NVDA running on a client (no additional administrative privileges required to install the add-on)
segment.target: 完全支持在客户端上运行的 NVDA 便携版（安装插件无需额外的管理员权限）

segment.source: Multiple active client sessions simultaneously
segment.target: 同时支持多个活动的客户端会话

segment.source: Remote desktop instantly available after NVDA start
segment.target: NVDA 启动后远程桌面即时可用

segment.source: Ability to control specific synthesizer and braille display settings without leaving the remote session
segment.target: 能够在不离开远程会话的情况下控制特定的语音合成器和盲文点显器设置

segment.source: Changelog
segment.target: 更新日志

segment.source: Version 2.0.3
segment.target: Version 2.0.3

segment.source: Caps lock synchronization on the client now relies on NVDA 2026.3, which lets RDAccess tell caps lock presses fed back by the remote desktop client apart from real key presses. Synchronization therefore also works when the session is not full screen but Windows key combinations are applied on the remote computer, and when the NVDA setting "Handle keys from other applications" is disabled. The client side of the synchronization requires NVDA 2026.3 or later and is no longer available on older versions of NVDA; the server side keeps working on every supported version.
segment.target: Caps lock synchronization on the client now relies on NVDA 2026.3, which lets RDAccess tell caps lock presses fed back by the remote desktop client apart from real key presses. Synchronization therefore also works when the session is not full screen but Windows key combinations are applied on the remote computer, and when the NVDA setting "Handle keys from other applications" is disabled. The client side of the synchronization requires NVDA 2026.3 or later and is no longer available on older versions of NVDA; the server side keeps working on every supported version.

segment.source: Version 2.0.2
segment.target: Version 2.0.2

segment.source: Fixed caps lock going out of sync between the client and the server when both NVDA instances use caps lock as an NVDA modifier key. Quickly repeated caps lock presses in a full screen session no longer toggle caps lock on the client, and when caps lock is really toggled within the session, the client now follows as soon as the session loses focus. This behavior is controlled by the new setting "Synchronize the caps lock key between client and server", which is enabled by default and needs to be enabled on both the client and the server to work correctly. Note that with the setting "Handle keys from other applications" disabled on the client, caps lock can still get out of sync.
segment.target: Fixed caps lock going out of sync between the client and the server when both NVDA instances use caps lock as an NVDA modifier key. Quickly repeated caps lock presses in a full screen session no longer toggle caps lock on the client, and when caps lock is really toggled within the session, the client now follows as soon as the session loses focus. This behavior is controlled by the new setting "Synchronize the caps lock key between client and server", which is enabled by default and needs to be enabled on both the client and the server to work correctly. Note that with the setting "Handle keys from other applications" disabled on the client, caps lock can still get out of sync.

segment.source: Version 2.0.1

When remote speech is switched on automatically, it now keeps speaking after a configuration profile switch. Previously, NVDA fell back to the synthesizer you have configured as soon as a profile was activated, for example when you moved to an application with its own profile.
segment.target: 当远程语音自动开启时，现在在切换配置后仍会持续朗读。此前，一旦激活独立配置（例如当您切换到拥有独立配置的应用程序时），NVDA 会立即回退到您配置的合成器。

segment.source: Renamed the option "Automatically recover remote speech after connection loss" to "Automatically switch to remote speech when available", which better describes what it does.
segment.target: 将“连接丢失后自动恢复远程语音”选项重命名为“可用时自动切换到远程语音”，该名称更准确地描述了其功能。

segment.source: Fixed frequent errors on the remote system when automatic language switching was enabled while using the remote synthesizer. Reporting of unsupported languages now reflects the languages supported by the speech synthesizer on the client.
segment.target: 修复了在使用远程合成器时启用自动语言切换的情况下，远程系统上频繁出现错误的问题。现在，对不支持的语言的报告会反映客户端语音合成器所支持的语言。

segment.source: On ARM64 versions of Windows, remote desktop clients that run under x64 emulation can now use RDAccess.
segment.target: 在 ARM64 版本的 Windows 上，在 x64 仿真下运行的远程桌面客户端现在可以使用 RDAccess。

segment.source: Adapted to the braille input changes introduced in NVDA 2026.3.
segment.target: 适配了 NVDA 2026.3 中引入的盲文输入更改。

segment.source: Version 2.0
Speech and braille coming from the remote system are now presented sooner, which makes working in a remote session feel more responsive.
segment.target: 来自远程系统的语音和盲文现在能更快地呈现，这使得在远程会话中工作感觉响应更迅速。

segment.source: When starting a remote server instance of NVDA, braille is now shown as soon as a remote session connects, instead of only after the first keypress or focus change.
segment.target: 当启动远程服务器实例的 NVDA 时，现在在远程会话连接后立即显示盲文，而不再需要等到首次按键或焦点更改后才显示。

segment.source: Fixed a freeze when switching away from the remote synthesizer or braille display while a session was disconnecting.
segment.target: 修复了在会话断开连接期间切换离开远程合成器或盲文点显器时发生的卡死问题。

segment.source: RDAccess now exchanges speech and braille using a new protocol modeled on the one used by NVDA's built-in Remote Access. It is more robust and no longer relies on the pickle format that a compromised remote system could abuse. The protocol version is chosen automatically, so a client and a server running different versions of RDAccess still work together.
segment.target: RDAccess 现在使用一种基于 NVDA 内置远程访问所使用协议的新协议来交换语音和盲文。该协议更加稳健，不再依赖可能被受感染的远程系统滥用的 pickle 格式。协议版本会自动选择，因此运行不同版本 RDAccess 的客户端和服务器仍可协同工作。

segment.source: The minimum compatible NVDA version is now 2026.1. Removed support for earlier versions.
segment.target: 最低兼容的 NVDA 版本现在为 2026.1。移除了对更早版本的支持。

segment.source: Adapted to the braille changes introduced in NVDA 2026.3.
segment.target: 适配了 NVDA 2026.3 中引入的盲文更改。

segment.source: Updated RD Pipe dependency to version 0.9.0.
segment.target: 将 RD Pipe 依赖项更新到 0.9.0 版本。

segment.source: RDAccess is now licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later.
segment.target: RDAccess 现在采用 GNU 通用公共许可证第 2 版或更高版本进行授权。

segment.source: Version 1.7.1
Hopefully fixed a bug in rd_pipe that caused the wrong virtual channel to be created.
segment.target: 希望修复了 rd_pipe 中导致创建错误虚拟通道的一个错误。

segment.source: Version 1.7
Removed secure desktop support.
segment.target: 移除了安全桌面支持。

segment.source: Added a client option "Incoming speech pitch change percentage" to shift the pitch of speech rendered from a remote NVDA, making remote and local speech audibly distinguishable.
segment.target: 添加了一个客户端选项“传入语音音高变化百分比”，用于改变来自远程 NVDA 的语音音高，使远程语音和本地语音在听觉上可区分。

segment.source: Version 1.6
Documented and improved Parallels RAS support.
segment.target: 记录并改进了 Parallels RAS 支持。

segment.source: The minimum compatible NVDA version is now 2025.1. Removed support for earlier versions.
segment.target: NVDA 的最低版本要求现在是 2025.1。已删除对早期版本的支持。

segment.source: Updated RdPipe dependency.
segment.target: 更新了 RdPipe 依赖项。

segment.source: Added the ability to configure RdPipe log level.
segment.target: 添加了配置 RdPipe 日志级别的选项。

segment.source: Added a viewer for the RdPipe log, available from the settings panel.
segment.target: 添加了 RdPipe 日志查看器，可从设置面板中打开。

segment.source: Improved uninstall behavior (no longer raise errors or remove Citrix support when Citrix is not available).
segment.target: 改进了卸载行为（当 Citrix 不可用时，不再引发错误或删除 Citrix 支持）。

segment.source: Version 1.5
Add the ability to create a debugging diagnostics report by means of a button in the RDAccess settings panel [#23](https://github.com/leonardder/rdAccess/pull/23).
segment.target: 在 RDAccess 设置面板中添加了一个按钮，用于创建调试诊断报告 [#23](https://github.com/leonardder/rdAccess/pull/23)。

segment.source: Support for multi-line braille displays in NVDA 2025.1 and newer [#19](https://github.com/leonardder/rdAccess/pull/13).
segment.target: 在 NVDA 2025.1 及更高版本中支持多行盲文点显器 [#19](https://github.com/leonardder/rdAccess/pull/13)。

segment.source: Getting Started
segment.target: 开始使用

segment.source: Install RDAccess on both a client and server copy of NVDA.
segment.target: 在客户端和服务器上的 NVDA 中都安装 RDAccess。

segment.source: The remote system should automatically start speaking using the local speech synthesizer.
segment.target: 远程系统应自动使用本地语音合成器开始朗读。

segment.source: If not, in the NVDA instance on the server, select the remote speech synthesizer from NVDA's synthesizer selection dialog.
segment.target: 如果未能自动朗读，请在服务器上的 NVDA 实例中，从 NVDA 的语音合成器选择对话框中选择远程语音合成器。

segment.source: To use braille, enable automatic braille display detection using the braille display selection dialog.
segment.target: 要使用盲文，请使用盲文点显器选择对话框启用盲文点显器自动检测。

segment.source: Configuration
segment.target: 配置

segment.source: After installation, the RDAccess add-on can be configured using NVDA's settings dialog, accessible from the NVDA Menu by choosing Preferences > Settings...
segment.target: 安装后，可以通过 NVDA 的设置面板设置 RDAccess 插件。

segment.source: Then, choose the Remote Desktop category.
segment.target: 可以从 NVDA 菜单中选择“选项”>“设置...”找到 RDAccess 设置类别。

segment.source: This dialog contains the following settings:
segment.target: 此面板包含以下设置：

segment.source: Enable Remote Desktop Accessibility for
segment.target: 为以下项启用远程桌面无障碍

segment.source: This list of checkboxes controls the operating mode of the add-on.
segment.target: 此复选框列表控制插件的操作模式。

segment.source: Choose between:
segment.target: 请在以下选项中选择：

segment.source: Incoming connections (Remote Desktop Server): Choose this option if the current instance of NVDA is running on a remote desktop server.
segment.target: 传入连接（远程桌面服务器）：如果当前 NVDA 实例运行在远程桌面服务器上，请选择此选项。

segment.source: Outgoing connections (Remote Desktop Client): Choose this option if the current instance of NVDA is running on a remote desktop client that connects to one or more servers.
segment.target: 传出连接（远程桌面客户端）：如果当前 NVDA 实例运行在连接到一个或多个服务器的远程桌面客户端上，请选择此选项。

segment.source: To ensure a smooth start with the add-on, all options are enabled by default.
segment.target: 为确保顺利开始使用插件，默认情况下所有选项均已启用。

segment.source: However, you are encouraged to disable server or client mode as appropriate.
segment.target: 但是，我们鼓励您根据实际情况禁用服务器或客户端模式。

segment.source: Synchronize the Caps Lock Key between Client and Server
segment.target: 在客户端与服务器之间同步大写锁定键状态

segment.source: When both the client and the server run NVDA with caps lock as an NVDA modifier key, the caps lock state can get out of sync, since the remote desktop client feeds caps lock presses back into the client system whenever it captures the keyboard, for example in a full screen session.
segment.target: When both the client and the server run NVDA with caps lock as an NVDA modifier key, the caps lock state can get out of sync, since the remote desktop client feeds caps lock presses back into the client system whenever it captures the keyboard, for example in a full screen session.

segment.source: When this option is enabled on the client, these fed back caps lock presses no longer toggle caps lock on the client.
segment.target: When this option is enabled on the client, these fed back caps lock presses no longer toggle caps lock on the client.

segment.source: When it is enabled on the server, the server reports its caps lock state to the client, which applies it as soon as the remote session loses focus.
segment.target: 当在服务器端启用此选项时，服务器会将其大写锁定状态报告给客户端，客户端将在远程会话失去焦点时立即应用该状态。

segment.source: For correct behavior, this option needs to be enabled on both the client and the server; it is enabled by default on both.
segment.target: 为确保正确行为，此选项需要在客户端和服务器端均启用；默认情况下，两端均处于启用状态。

segment.source: On the client, this option requires NVDA 2026.3 or later; the server side works with every NVDA version supported by the add-on.
segment.target: On the client, this option requires NVDA 2026.3 or later; the server side works with every NVDA version supported by the add-on.

segment.source: Note that while a remote desktop session window has focus, caps lock presses sent by other software, such as NVDA Remote Access, are suppressed on the client as well.
segment.target: Note that while a remote desktop session window has focus, caps lock presses sent by other software, such as NVDA Remote Access, are suppressed on the client as well.

segment.source: Automatically Switch to Remote Speech when Available
segment.target: 连接丢失后自动恢复远程语音

segment.source: This option is only available in server mode.
segment.target: 此选项仅在服务器模式下可用。

segment.source: It ensures that Remote Speech is activated as soon as a remote desktop client offers it, similar to braille display auto-detection, and that the connection is automatically re-established when it is lost.
segment.target: 它确保当远程语音合成器处于活动状态且连接丢失时，连接将自动重新建立，类似于盲文点显器的自动检测。

segment.source: While Remote Speech is active this way, your configured synthesizer is left untouched, and switching configuration profiles no longer falls back to it.
segment.target: 当远程语音以此方式激活时，您配置的合成器将保持原样不受影响，切换配置时也不再回退到该合成器。

segment.source: This option is enabled by default.
segment.target: 此选项默认启用。

segment.source: It is strongly encouraged to leave this option enabled if the Remote Desktop server has no audio output.
segment.target: 如果远程桌面服务器没有音频输出，强烈建议保持此选项启用。

segment.source: Allow Remote System to Control Driver Settings
segment.target: 允许远程系统控制驱动程序设置

segment.source: When enabled in the client, this option allows you to control driver settings (such as synthesizer voice and pitch) from the remote system.
segment.target: 在客户端启用此选项后，您可以从远程系统控制驱动程序设置（例如语音合成器的语音和音高）。

segment.source: Changes made on the remote system will automatically reflect locally.
segment.target: 在远程系统上所做的更改将自动反映在本地。

segment.source: Persist Client Support When Exiting NVDA
segment.target: 退出 NVDA 时保持客户端支持

segment.source: This client option, available on installed copies of NVDA, ensures that the client portion of NVDA is loaded in your remote desktop client even when NVDA is not running.
segment.target: 此客户端选项在 NVDA 安装版上可用，其可确保即使 NVDA 未运行时，NVDA 的客户端部分也会加载到您的远程桌面客户端中。

segment.source: To use the client portion of RDAccess, changes need to be made in the Windows Registry.
segment.target: 要使用 RDAccess 的客户端部分，需要在 Windows 注册表中进行更改。

segment.source: The add-on ensures that these changes are made under the profile of the current user, requiring no administrative privileges.
segment.target: 该插件确保这些更改在当前用户的配置文件下进行，无需管理员权限。

segment.source: Therefore, NVDA can automatically apply the necessary changes when loaded and undo these changes when exiting NVDA, ensuring compatibility with portable versions of NVDA.
segment.target: 因此，NVDA 可以在加载时自动应用必要的更改，并在退出 NVDA 时撤销这些更改，从而确保与 NVDA 便携版兼容。

segment.source: This option is disabled by default.
segment.target: 此选项默认禁用。

segment.source: However, if you are running an installed copy and you are the only user of the system, it is advised to enable this option for smooth operation when connecting to a remote system after NVDA starts.
segment.target: 但是，如果您运行的是安装版并且是系统的唯一用户，建议启用此选项，以便在 NVDA 启动后连接到远程系统时能顺利操作。

segment.source: Enable Default Remote Desktop Support
segment.target: 启用默认远程桌面支持

segment.source: This option, enabled by default, ensures that the client portion of RDAccess is loaded in the Microsoft Remote Desktop client (mstsc) when starting NVDA.
segment.target: 此选项默认启用，确保在启动 NVDA 时，RDAccess 的客户端部分会加载到 Microsoft 远程桌面 客户端 (mstsc) 中。

segment.source: This is also required for VMware Horizon, Parallels RAS, Azure Virtual Desktop. etc.
segment.target: 这也是 VMware Horizon、Parallels RAS、Azure Virtual Desktop 等虚拟化平台的必需项。

segment.source: Changes made through this option will be automatically undone when exiting NVDA unless persistent client support is enabled.
segment.target: 除非启用了持久客户端支持，否则通过此选项所做的更改将在退出 NVDA 时自动撤销。

segment.source: Enable Citrix Workspace Support
segment.target: 启用 Citrix Workspace 支持

segment.source: This option, enabled by default, ensures that the client portion of RDAccess is loaded in the Citrix Workspace app when starting NVDA.
segment.target: 此选项默认启用，确保在启动 NVDA 时，RDAccess 的客户端部分会加载到 Citrix Workspace 应用中。

segment.source: Changes made through this option will be automatically undone when exiting NVDA unless persistent client support is enabled.
segment.target: 除非启用了持久客户端支持，否则通过此选项所做的更改将在退出 NVDA 时自动撤销。

segment.source: This option is available only under the following conditions:
segment.target: 此选项仅在以下条件下可用：

segment.source: Citrix Workspace is installed.
segment.target: 已安装 Citrix Workspace。

segment.source: Note that the Windows Store version of the app is not supported due to limitations in the app itself.
segment.target: 请注意，由于应用本身的限制，不支持该应用的 Windows 应用商店版本。

segment.source: It is possible to register RDAccess under the current user context.
segment.target: 可以在当前用户上下文中注册 RDAccess。

segment.source: After installing the app, you have to start a remote session once to enable this.
segment.target: 安装该应用后，您必须启动一次远程会话才能启用此功能。

segment.source: Notify of connection changes with
segment.target: 连接状态变更通知

segment.source: This combo box allows you to control notifications received when a remote system opens or closes the remote speech or braille connection.
segment.target: 此组合框允许您控制远程系统打开或关闭远程语音或盲文连接时收到的通知。

segment.source: You can choose between:
segment.target: 您可以选择：

segment.source: Off (No notifications)
segment.target: 关闭（无通知）

segment.source: Incoming Speech Pitch Change Percentage
segment.target: 传入语音音高变化百分比

segment.source: This client option shifts the pitch of speech rendered locally when it originates from a remote NVDA, making remote and local speech audibly distinguishable.
segment.target: 此客户端选项用于改变当语音来自远程 NVDA 时在本地呈现的语音音高，使远程语音和本地语音在听觉上可区分。

segment.source: The value is a percentage between -100 and 100.
segment.target: 该值为 -100 到 100 之间的百分比。

segment.source: Positive values raise pitch, negative values lower it.
segment.target: 正值提高音高，负值降低音高。

segment.source: A value of 0 disables the shift.
segment.target: 值为 0 时禁用音高变化。

segment.source: The default is 10.
segment.target: 默认值为 10。

segment.source: The shift is applied only when the local synthesizer supports pitch commands; synthesizers without pitch support are unaffected.
segment.target: 此音高变化仅在本地合成器支持音高命令时生效；不支持音高调整的合成器不受影响。

segment.source: Open diagnostics report
segment.target: 打开诊断报告

segment.source: This button opens a browsable message with JSON output containing several diagnostics that can possibly aid in debugging.
segment.target: 此按钮打开一个可浏览的消息，其中包含 JSON 格式的输出，其中包含多个诊断信息，这些信息可能有助于调试。

segment.source: When [filing an issue at GitHub][4], you might be asked to provide this report.
segment.target: 当您[在 GitHub 上提交问题][4]时，可能会要求您提供此报告。

segment.source: Citrix Specific Instructions
segment.target: Citrix 特定说明

segment.source: There are important points to note when using RDAccess with the Citrix Workspace app:
segment.target: 使用 RDAccess 与 Citrix Workspace 应用时，有一些重要的注意事项：

segment.source: Client-Side Requirements
segment.target: 客户端要求

segment.source: The Windows Store variant of the app is *not* supported.
segment.target: 不支持 Windows 应用商店版本的应用。

segment.source: After installing Citrix Workspace, you need to start a remote session once to let RDAccess register itself.
segment.target: 安装 Citrix Workspace 后，您需要启动一次远程会话以让 RDAccess 进行注册。

segment.source: This occurs because the application copies system settings to user settings during the initial session setup.
segment.target: 这是因为该应用程序在初始会话设置期间会将系统设置复制到用户设置。

segment.source: Following this, RDAccess can register itself under the current user context.
segment.target: 在此之后，RDAccess 才能在当前用户上下文中自注册。

segment.source: Server-Side Requirement
segment.target: 服务端要求

segment.source: In Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops 2109, Citrix enabled the so-called virtual channel allow list, restricting third-party virtual channels, including the channel required by RDAccess, by default.
segment.target: 在 Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops 2109 中，Citrix 启用了所谓的虚拟通道允许列表，默认情况下限制了第三方虚拟通道，包括 RDAccess 所需的通道。

segment.source: For more information, [see this Citrix blog post](https://www.citrix.com/blogs/2021/10/14/virtual-channel-allow-list-now-enabled-by-default/).
segment.target: 有关更多信息，[请参阅此 Citrix 博客文章](https://www.citrix.com/blogs/2021/10/14/virtual-channel-allow-list-now-enabled-by-default/)。

segment.source: Explicitly allowing the RdPipe channel required by RDAccess is not yet tested.
segment.target: 明确允许 RDAccess 所需的 RdPipe 通道尚未经过测试。

segment.source: For now, it is best to disable the allow list altogether.
segment.target: 目前，最好完全禁用该允许列表。

segment.source: If your system administrator has concerns, feel free to [address the issue here][3].
segment.target: 如果您的系统管理员有疑虑，请随时[在此处提出问题][3]。
